BoundedStack class compile: 'capacity: aCapacity
	(aCapacity isInteger and: [aCapacity > 0]) ifFalse: [
		self error: ''capacity must be a positive integer''].
	^self basicNew initializeWithCapacity: aCapacity' classified: 'instance creation'.
BoundedStack class compile: 'new
	self error: ''capacity must be a positive integer''' classified: 'instance creation'.
BoundedStack compile: 'initializeWithCapacity: aCapacity
	super initialize.
	capacity := aCapacity.
	elements := OrderedCollection new.
	^self' classified: 'initialization'.
BoundedStack compile: 'push: anObject
	elements size = capacity ifTrue: [self error: ''stack is full''].
	elements addLast: anObject.
	^anObject' classified: 'operations'.
BoundedStack compile: 'pop
	self assertNotEmpty.
	^elements removeLast' classified: 'operations'.
BoundedStack compile: 'top
	self assertNotEmpty.
	^elements last' classified: 'operations'.
BoundedStack compile: 'assertNotEmpty
	self isEmpty ifTrue: [self error: ''stack is empty'']' classified: 'private'.
BoundedStack compile: 'isEmpty
	^elements isEmpty' classified: 'testing'.
BoundedStack compile: 'size
	^elements size' classified: 'accessing'.

BoundedStackTest compile: 'testNewStackIsEmpty
	| stack |
	stack := BoundedStack capacity: 2.
	self assert: stack isEmpty.
	self assert: stack size equals: 0' classified: 'tests'.
BoundedStackTest compile: 'testPushAddsObjectOnTop
	| stack first second |
	stack := BoundedStack capacity: 2.
	first := Object new.
	second := Object new.
	stack push: first.
	self deny: stack isEmpty.
	self assert: stack size equals: 1.
	self assert: stack top == first.
	stack push: second.
	self assert: stack size equals: 2.
	self assert: stack top == second' classified: 'tests'.
BoundedStackTest compile: 'testPopReturnsAndRemovesObjectsInLastInFirstOutOrder
	| stack first second |
	stack := BoundedStack capacity: 2.
	first := Object new.
	second := Object new.
	stack push: first; push: second.
	self assert: stack pop == second.
	self assert: stack size equals: 1.
	self assert: stack top == first.
	self assert: stack pop == first.
	self assert: stack isEmpty.
	self assert: stack size equals: 0' classified: 'tests'.
BoundedStackTest compile: 'testTopDoesNotRemoveObject
	| stack object |
	stack := BoundedStack capacity: 1.
	object := Object new.
	stack push: object.
	self assert: stack top == object.
	self assert: stack top == object.
	self assert: stack size equals: 1.
	self deny: stack isEmpty.
	self assert: stack pop == object' classified: 'tests'.
BoundedStackTest compile: 'testPushOnFullStackFailsWithoutChangingContents
	| stack first second |
	stack := BoundedStack capacity: 2.
	first := Object new.
	second := Object new.
	stack push: first; push: second.
	self should: [stack push: Object new] raise: Error withMessageText: ''stack is full''.
	self assert: stack size equals: 2.
	self assert: stack pop == second.
	self assert: stack pop == first' classified: 'tests'.
BoundedStackTest compile: 'testPopOnEmptyStackFails
	| stack |
	stack := BoundedStack capacity: 1.
	self should: [stack pop] raise: Error withMessageText: ''stack is empty''.
	self assert: stack isEmpty.
	self assert: stack size equals: 0.
	stack push: #afterError.
	self assert: stack pop equals: #afterError' classified: 'tests'.
BoundedStackTest compile: 'testTopOnEmptyStackFails
	| stack |
	stack := BoundedStack capacity: 1.
	self should: [stack top] raise: Error withMessageText: ''stack is empty''.
	self assert: stack isEmpty.
	self assert: stack size equals: 0.
	stack push: #afterError.
	self assert: stack top equals: #afterError' classified: 'tests'.
BoundedStackTest compile: 'testDrainedStackRejectsPopAndTop
	| stack |
	stack := BoundedStack capacity: 1.
	stack push: #item; pop.
	self should: [stack pop] raise: Error withMessageText: ''stack is empty''.
	self should: [stack top] raise: Error withMessageText: ''stack is empty''' classified: 'tests'.
BoundedStackTest compile: 'testPopMakesCapacityAvailableAgain
	| stack |
	stack := BoundedStack capacity: 1.
	stack push: #first.
	self should: [stack push: #overflow] raise: Error withMessageText: ''stack is full''.
	self assert: stack pop equals: #first.
	stack push: #second.
	self assert: stack size equals: 1.
	self assert: stack pop equals: #second' classified: 'tests'.
BoundedStackTest compile: 'testPositiveIntegerCapacitiesAreAccepted
	#(1 2 10) do: [:limit |
		| stack |
		stack := BoundedStack capacity: limit.
		1 to: limit do: [:index | stack push: index].
		self assert: stack size equals: limit.
		self should: [stack push: #overflow] raise: Error withMessageText: ''stack is full'']' classified: 'tests'.
BoundedStackTest compile: 'testZeroCapacityIsRejected
	self should: [BoundedStack capacity: 0] raise: Error withMessageText: ''capacity must be a positive integer''' classified: 'tests'.
BoundedStackTest compile: 'testNegativeIntegerCapacitiesAreRejected
	#(-1 -10) do: [:invalid |
		self should: [BoundedStack capacity: invalid] raise: Error withMessageText: ''capacity must be a positive integer'']' classified: 'tests'.
BoundedStackTest compile: 'testNonIntegerCapacitiesAreRejected
	{1.0. 1.5. (3 / 2). ''2''. #two. nil. true. false. Object new} do: [:invalid |
		self should: [BoundedStack capacity: invalid] raise: Error withMessageText: ''capacity must be a positive integer'']' classified: 'tests'.
BoundedStackTest compile: 'testCapacityIsRequired
	self should: [BoundedStack new] raise: Error withMessageText: ''capacity must be a positive integer''' classified: 'tests'.
BoundedStackTest compile: 'testNilCanBeStored
	| stack |
	stack := BoundedStack capacity: 1.
	stack push: nil.
	self deny: stack isEmpty.
	self assert: stack size equals: 1.
	self assert: stack top isNil.
	self assert: stack pop isNil.
	self assert: stack isEmpty' classified: 'tests'.
BoundedStackTest compile: 'testStacksHaveIndependentContentsAndCapacities
	| first second |
	first := BoundedStack capacity: 1.
	second := BoundedStack capacity: 2.
	first push: #first.
	self assert: second isEmpty.
	second push: #second; push: #third.
	self assert: first size equals: 1.
	self assert: first top equals: #first.
	self assert: second size equals: 2.
	self assert: second top equals: #third' classified: 'tests'.
